details:
I see a lot of posts about new nameplate feedback, but I haven't seen any yet describing how harmful they will be to VRChat and its community.

If the nameplates go live as-is, I will have to turn off nameplates completely. The ubiquitous always-visible nameplate icons show through what seems like an unlimited distance. For example, in the Fish! world, the icons from players hundreds of in-game meters away will render on top of the game world UI in many cases. Without turning off the nameplate UI, this can make playing the game (and probably others) frustrating enough to quit. Probably not ideal since these games likely bring in a disproportionate amount of revenue to VRChat.

It will almost assuredly kill VRC+ revenue. I'm one of those nerds with the Top 100 VRC+ gifter badges. I occasionally will gift VRC+ to those who don't have it. Right now it is easy for me to identify who does and does not have VRC+; once this update drops, it won't even be worth it. I don't want to have to go through several menu clicks just to see if they have the VRC+ supporter badge. (Is it even possible to verify VRC+ status if they aren't displaying the badge on their profile?). Either way, it's not as fun to gift VRC+ to those who already keep their subscription running and I'm not going to spend several minutes combing through profiles after this update when I feel the need to gift VRC+. My gifting of VRC+ to random strangers will almost assuredly drop to zero after this update.

The "custom profile icon" is a meaningless benefit of VRC+. You can upload any world in a few minutes with the screenshot you want on a plane, and use the in-game camera to take a screenshot of any custom profile icon you want. Taking away the most visible VRC+ benefit will almost assuredly kill some of the interest in subscribing, especially when bios are ignored by most strangers and the monthly VRC+ item drops have become extremely lackluster.

Not having Group Banners as the only source of banners, too, will hurt VRChat's social fabric. Sure, some people will use a meme group simply for having a weird banner. Low battery, verified XYZ, etc. But most people don't do that. They represent groups that are a major part of who they are, or represent some really cool aspect of VRChat. I have found a *ton* of cool and interesting groups through the banners that people represent. I've found immediate icebreakers from someone's represented group. I feel that this part of VRChat will simply fall over and die, especially when combined with represented groups being sidelined in the full bio. The point of the group banner is that it represents some sort of social, shared interest amongst many in VRChat rather than the interests of one single individual. This feature absolutely should not be changed from how it works on live. Removing social icebreakers, and removing ways to find like-minded groups spontaneously are absolutely toxic to the goals of this game.

I know I'm just one voice and will probably get flamed for a revenue-focused feedback post for VRChat, but I just want this game to survive financially in the long-term. I'm afraid these changes will harm the game's viability on that front, as well as just making the experience worse for everyone playing from a social perspective.
title: [1880] New Nameplates are harmful to the social fabric of VRChat
